# 🏗 Scaffold-ETH 2 | Docs

Open-source toolkit for building dapps

- [Scaffold-ETH 2](https://docs.scaffoldeth.io/index): Open-source toolkit for building decentralized applications on Ethereum.
- [Installation](https://docs.scaffoldeth.io/quick-start/installation): Requirements and installation methods to get started with Scaffold ETH-2.
- [Environment](https://docs.scaffoldeth.io/quick-start/environment): How to set up your development environment for Scaffold ETH-2.
- [Components](https://docs.scaffoldeth.io/components/): Pre-built React components for common web3 use cases.
- [Address](https://docs.scaffoldeth.io/components/Address): Display Ethereum addresses with ENS resolution and copy feature.
- [AddressInput](https://docs.scaffoldeth.io/components/AddressInput): Input field with address validation and ENS support.
- [Balance](https://docs.scaffoldeth.io/components/Balance): Display ETH balance with USD conversion.
- [BlockieAvatar](https://docs.scaffoldeth.io/components/BlockieAvatar): Generate blockie avatars for Ethereum addresses.
- [EtherInput](https://docs.scaffoldeth.io/components/EtherInput): Input field for ETH amounts with USD toggle.
- [BaseInput](https://docs.scaffoldeth.io/components/BaseInput): Base input component with default styling.
- [IntegerInput](https://docs.scaffoldeth.io/components/IntegerInput): Input field for integer values with wei conversion.
- [RainbowKitCustomConnectButton](https://docs.scaffoldeth.io/components/RainbowKitCustomConnectButton): Enhanced wallet connect button with balance display.
- [Hooks](https://docs.scaffoldeth.io/hooks/): Custom React hooks for seamless smart contract interactions.
- [useScaffoldReadContract](https://docs.scaffoldeth.io/hooks/useScaffoldReadContract): Read data from smart contract functions.
- [useScaffoldWriteContract](https://docs.scaffoldeth.io/hooks/useScaffoldWriteContract): Send transactions to smart contract functions.
- [useScaffoldWatchContractEvent](https://docs.scaffoldeth.io/hooks/useScaffoldWatchContractEvent): Subscribe to real-time smart contract events.
- [useScaffoldEventHistory](https://docs.scaffoldeth.io/hooks/useScaffoldEventHistory): Retrieve historical event logs from smart contracts.
- [useDeployedContractInfo](https://docs.scaffoldeth.io/hooks/useDeployedContractInfo): Fetch ABI and address of deployed contracts.
- [useScaffoldContract](https://docs.scaffoldeth.io/hooks/useScaffoldContract): Get a contract instance for direct read/write interactions.
- [useTransactor](https://docs.scaffoldeth.io/hooks/useTransactor): Handle transactions with built-in UI feedback.
- [External Contracts](https://docs.scaffoldeth.io/external-contracts/): Interact with contracts not deployed by your SE-2 instance.
- [Get balance of the connected account](https://docs.scaffoldeth.io/recipes/GetCurrentBalanceFromAccount): Learn how to retrieve and display the ETH balance of the connected account in your dApp.
- [Write to contract with writeContractAsync button](https://docs.scaffoldeth.io/recipes/WriteToContractWriteAsyncButton): Learn how to create a button that executes the writeContractAsync function to interact with a smart contract.
- [Read a uint from a contract](https://docs.scaffoldeth.io/recipes/ReadUintFromContract): Learn how to read from contract functions which accepts arguments / no arguments and display them on UI.
- [Wagmi useWriteContract with transaction status](https://docs.scaffoldeth.io/recipes/WagmiContractWriteWithFeedback): Show feedback on transaction status to user by `useWriteContract` along with `useTransactor`
- [Add a custom chain](https://docs.scaffoldeth.io/recipes/add-custom-chain): Learn how to add custom chains to your project.
- [Deploy Smart Contracts](https://docs.scaffoldeth.io/deploying/deploy-smart-contracts): Deploy and verify smart contracts to live networks.
- [Deploy NextJS App](https://docs.scaffoldeth.io/deploying/deploy-nextjs-app): Deploy your dApp frontend to Vercel or IPFS.
- [Disable Type & Lint Checks](https://docs.scaffoldeth.io/disable-type-linting-error-checks): Skip TypeScript and linting checks during development or deployment.
- [Extensions](https://docs.scaffoldeth.io/extensions/): Modular add-ons for extending Scaffold-ETH 2 functionality.
- [Install Extensions](https://docs.scaffoldeth.io/extensions/howToInstall): Add extensions to your Scaffold-ETH 2 project.
- [Create Extensions](https://docs.scaffoldeth.io/extensions/createExtensions): Build custom extensions for Scaffold-ETH 2.
- [Build with AI](https://docs.scaffoldeth.io/build-with-ai/): Use AI coding agents to build faster with Scaffold-ETH 2.
- [AGENTS.md](https://docs.scaffoldeth.io/build-with-ai/agents-md): How AGENTS.md gives AI coding agents context about your Scaffold-ETH 2 project.
- [Skills](https://docs.scaffoldeth.io/build-with-ai/skills): Reusable AI agent instructions for adding features to Scaffold-ETH 2.
- [drizzle-neon](https://docs.scaffoldeth.io/build-with-ai/drizzle-neon): Add a PostgreSQL database with Drizzle ORM to a Scaffold-ETH 2 project
- [eip-5792](https://docs.scaffoldeth.io/build-with-ai/eip-5792): Add EIP-5792 batched transaction support to a Scaffold-ETH 2 project
- [erc-721](https://docs.scaffoldeth.io/build-with-ai/erc-721): Add an ERC-721 NFT contract to a Scaffold-ETH 2 project
- [openzeppelin](https://docs.scaffoldeth.io/build-with-ai/openzeppelin): Develop smart contracts using OpenZeppelin Contracts library
- [ponder](https://docs.scaffoldeth.io/build-with-ai/ponder): Integrate Ponder into a Scaffold-ETH 2 project for blockchain event indexing
- [siwe](https://docs.scaffoldeth.io/build-with-ai/siwe): Add Sign-In with Ethereum (SIWE) authentication to a Scaffold-ETH 2 project
- [subgraph](https://docs.scaffoldeth.io/build-with-ai/subgraph): Integrate The Graph subgraph into a Scaffold-ETH 2 project for indexing blockchain events
- [x402](https://docs.scaffoldeth.io/build-with-ai/x402): Add x402 payment-gated routes to a Scaffold-ETH 2 project
- [Contributing](https://docs.scaffoldeth.io/contributing/): How to contribute to the Scaffold-ETH 2 project.
- [Issues](https://docs.scaffoldeth.io/contributing/Issues): Report bugs, request features, or find issues to solve.
- [Pull Requests](https://docs.scaffoldeth.io/contributing/pullRequests): Submit code changes using the fork-and-pull workflow.
